Chapter 895: Chapter 2 Little Guy, Meekly Offer Your Flesh (Please Subscribe)

Swoosh.

Wu Xiangyan had not gotten very far when the surrounding time and space began to change, and time and space were compressed until they were held between Lin Yuan’s palms.

“You?”

“You’re not Gao Wuyou?!”

“Who exactly are you?!!”

Wu Xiangyan’s face displayed extreme terror; he had once glimpsed a Jade Immortal Carriage crossing the sky from afar, and the suppression of the many rules it represented was still imprinted in his heart.

But compared to the Jade Immortal Carriage, which was unattainably high, the time and space manipulated by Gao Wuyou at this moment seemed as trivial as dust; the two were not on the same level at all.

“Who am I?” Lin Yuan slightly smiled, “You don’t need to know that.”

With a mere thought from Lin Yuan, Wu Xiangyan’s physical body and soul were erased, leaving behind only the fragments of his spirit that contained memories.

Having just entered the Immortal Realm, Lin Yuan naturally wanted to understand the situation in the Immortal Realm. Aside from Gao Wuyou’s memories, Wu Xiangyan’s memories were naturally worth examining.

“Hm?”

“Not dead?”

After completely erasing Wu Xiangyan, Lin Yuan faintly felt the presence of the other’s causality through the connection of cause and effect at an incredibly distant place.

…

In a deep underground cavern.

When Wu Xiangyan was erased by Lin Yuan, a patch of black water in this underground cavern began to ripple rapidly, and the spirit will belonging to Wu Xiangyan awakened deep within the water.

“I’m dead…”

The revived spirit will was slightly astonished, followed by a succession of images flashing through its mind from just before death.

The black water was Wu Xiangyan’s Life Pool, which he had refined at a great cost. Once his true body perished, the fragments of spirit will in the Life Pool would rapidly grow to perfection.

That is to say, he would be ‘resurrected.’

“Such a terrifying method, what’s the deal with that Gao Wuyou? How could he have such a masterful control over the rules?”

The ‘resurrected’ Wu Xiangyan still had a look of terror, “That’s impossible. If Gao Wuyou had such strength, how could I have seriously wounded him before?”

Wu Xiangyan couldn’t understand.

“Fortunately, I spent most of my fortune refining this Life Pool; otherwise, I would have completely perished just now.”

Wu Xiangyan steadfastly thought to himself, feeling fortunate in his heart.

For a cultivator at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, refining a Life Pool is no easy feat.

Only someone like Wu Xiangyan, who secretly plundered other weaker cultivators, could barely scrape together the cost to refine a Life Pool.

“That Gao Wuyou, he must have a big secret. If I tell those Golden Immortals and Jade Immortals about this secret, I should be able to receive a reward.”

Although Wu Xiangyan ‘resurrected,’ his status was akin to starting over, urgently needing abundant resources to recover.

And Gao Wuyou’s secret is the key to his rise once again.

Even if those Golden Immortals are not interested in Gao Wuyou, the opportunities related to the Jade Immortal would have some allure.

At this moment, Wu Xiangyan acknowledged himself clearly, realizing that regaining the Jade Immortal opportunity was practically impossible.

Moreover, Wu Xiangyan did not dare to confront Gao Wuyou again, as the mastery and suppression over time, space, and many rules still caused him to tremble with insecurity.

Too terrifying.

But while he did not dare to confront Gao Wuyou, he could still betray information regarding Gao Wuyou and the opportunity of the Jade Immortal.

Just as Wu Xiangyan planned to rest for a while before leaving the underground.

Buzz buzz buzz…

An invisible attack, following the omnipresent connection of causal rules, crossed countless distances before crashing down thunderously.

“No!!!!!”

The spirit will within the depths of the black Life Pool had no chance to react before all the black water turned into dust, and the spirit will within it was equally annihilated.

…

“Now it’s completely resolved.”

Lin Yuan withdrew his hand. Upon realizing that Wu Xiangyan was still alive, he casually performed a Causal Curse Killing.

Lin Yuan’s true realm is Level Eleven Perfect; and Wu Xiangyan, merely Eighth Layer. To curse kill a life at such a level, Lin Yuan did not even need to pay any price.

“Find a place to recover from injuries.”

Lin Yuan surveyed himself and silently disappeared from the spot.

Although the poison of the demonic marrow had been cured, his gravely injured flesh still needed to recover.

…

Deep within a mountain range.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in a cavern.

“The environment of the Immortal Realm, far surpasses that of the Spirit Realm…”

Lin Yuan finally had time to sense the atmosphere of the Immortal Realm.

Even in this remote mountain range, he could still feel the rich Immortal Qi permeating the air.

In such an environment, the hope of cultivation to the stage of Transcendance was unfathomably more potent than in the Spirit Realm.

“The Ancestor of the Immortal Path…”

Lin Yuan looked up at the sky, feeling faintly with his level, like a colossal entity, resembling the sun overlooking all beings, illuminating life.

All the cultivators within the boundless Immortal Cultivation System originated from that colossal entity.

“It truly is ultimate.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

At this moment, he was utterly certain that the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, who spread the Immortal Cultivation System, was indeed an ultimate existence.

“Only…”

Lin Yuan furrowed his brow slightly.

Within his perception, in addition to the Ancestor of the Immortal Path shining over life like the brilliant sun.

Deep in the underground, there was also an unfathomable colossal entity. Its aura was completely opposite to that of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, filled with endless madness and destruction.

“Another ultimate existence?”

“The ultimate from the depths of the Demon Abyss?”

Lin Yuan was aware of Gao Wuyou’s memories and understood the existence of the Demon Abyss.

That place was a confluence of all evil and madness, where countless demons crawled out of the Demon Abyss every moment, and then they were suppressed by the immortals from the thirty-three Immortal Domains.

“The Ancestor of the Immortal Path and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss?”

“That’s rather interesting.”

Lin Yuan stroked his chin, vaguely speculating that this was a struggle between two ultimate existences, and it seemed that the Ancestor of the Immortal Path had the upper hand, for now.

At least in the Immortal Realm, the immortals generally were dominant against those demons.

And whether it was the Spirit Realm or the Central Divine China World, the Immortal Cultivation System prevailed, but what about the Demonic Tao Cultivation System? Indeed, it existed but wasn’t the main trend.

This also reflected the outcome of the struggle between the two ultimate existences, somewhat invisibly.

…

Next.

Lin Yuan took out the soul judgment artifact carrying Wu Xiangyan’s memories and began to quickly browse through them.

Compared with the original Gao Wuyou, Wu Xiangyan’s memories were much more heterogeneous, including not only cultivation but also many fragments of memories plundered from weaker cultivators.

All in all, Wu Xiangyan was someone who would stoop to any means for cultivation.

In fact, such people were not uncommon in the Immortal Realm, even quite frequent, and there were too many instances of brothers turning against each other for opportunities.

“He did accumulate quite a few cultivation resources.”

Lin Yuan sorted through Wu Xiangyan’s spoils of war, which were a considerable fortune for someone at the same Transcendance Tribulation Stage level, but to Lin Yuan, they were quite unimpressive and hardly caught his eye.

“Let’s take a look at the Jade Immortal opportunity.”

With a thought, Lin Yuan took out a piece of white, translucent jade.

A mysterious aura lingered on the jade, an aura that surpassed that of a Golden Immortal, and it was the basis for Wu Xiangyan’s assertion that it was a Jade Immortal opportunity.

Aside from the opportunities left by a Jade Immortal, no other opportunities would have such aura remaining.

“Jade Immortal?”

Lin Yuan’s face showed interest. A Jade Immortal corresponded to a Level Eleven powerhouse in the Main Universe. Such an opportunity left by a being of this level, for Lin Yuan at his prime, was naturally not much.

But now, Lin Yuan was practically starting all over again, and he was quite interested.

Thinking of this, Lin Yuan separated out a wisp of consciousness to begin refining the jade.

The jade was presumably a type of spatial Immortal Artifact, containing vast internal space.

Before long.

Lin Yuan completely refined the jade.

“These…”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness entered the jade, inside was an expansive world densely packed with countless resources, neatly stacked.

“Cloud Crane Grass, Dark Water Immortal Lotus, Ten Thousand Souls Fruit, Two Lives Tree…”

Lin Yuan looked and saw many resources and spirit fruits that were extremely rare in Gao Wuyou and Wu Xiangyan’s memories, and even some that they had only heard about, piled up like small mountains.

This was just what Gao Wuyou and Wu Xiangyan had heard about; most of the resources were unheard of to them, but based on the energy aura radiating from these resources, Lin Yuan could tell they were valuable.

“Is this the Jade Immortal opportunity? It should be more accurately called the entire fortune of a Jade Immortal?”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. The resources within the jade had far exceeded something as simple as an opportunity; many Jade Immortals’ entire fortunes probably couldn’t compare.

And the arrangement of these resources was very orderly, from low to high, as if specially prepared for someone later.

“Am I this lucky? Just as my consciousness awakens, I come across such a great benefit?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that while these resources couldn’t restore him to his prime, they should be enough to bring him back to the Tenth Rank Summit.

“Hm?”

“And there’s a lot of Immortal Path Skill inheritances?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze turned to a corner of the world within the jade, where piles of jade slips were clearly recording various skills and inheritances.

Lin Yuan continued to disperse his consciousness to explore each one.

A complete Immortal Cultivation System would undoubtedly provide a good boost for Lin Yuan to open up the Eleventh Layer chapter of the Martial Tao evolutionary path.

“Golden Immortal? Jade Immortal?”

“Golden nature is indestructible, jade nature never falls, the body like gold, the soul like jade, perpetually unyielding…”

Lin Yuan quickly absorbed the Immortal Path Skill inheritances recorded in these jades, which offered a completely different exposition on the essence of cultivation evolution compared to those Level Eleven evolutionary paths in the Main Universe.

Just as Lin Yuan was browsing through each jade slip.

Among all the jade slips, one that was purple was quietly situated there.

Soon.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness delved into this purple jade slip.

Buzz!!!

A massive consciousness within the jade slip awakened, swiftly spreading along Lin Yuan’s consciousness, piercing through the soul barrier, and soon arriving outside the Spirit World.

“Ha haha, the old ancestor has waited for millions of years, and now the time has finally come.”

This consciousness was extremely excited, spreading incessantly along Lin Yuan’s consciousness, breaking through the soul barrier, and quickly approaching the exterior of the Spirit World.

“Little fellow, obediently offer up your body. Rest assured, the old ancestor is a supreme Jade Immortal, to possess your body is the greatest honor…”

This massive consciousness that resurrected from the purple jade slip couldn’t wait to enter the Spirit World, intending to replace Lin Yuan’s spiritual will, and truly resurrect.

“With the old ancestor here, your body is destined to shake the thirty-three Immortal Domains…”

The resurrected consciousness from the purple jade slip swiftly entered the Spirit World and was about to locate Lin Yuan’s spiritual will when it suddenly stopped, and the spread of its consciousness halted abruptly.

For before it was a towering figure seated cross-legged, an image that seemed to fill the heavens and earth, supreme and vast, strong and broad.

Compared to this towering figure, the newly awakened consciousness from the purple jade slip was like a speck of dust.

“This…”

The resurrecting consciousness of the Jade Immortal fell silent.
